verdict.rationale: Recurly's first-party docs describe entitlements that define which features or content a subscriber can access. They are linked to plans or items, granted automatically on subscription, and checked in real time via the Recurly API across web, mobile and app-store platforms. Official client libraries in seven languages support runtime access from application code. Missing for 10: explicit modeling of numeric limits/quotas as entitlements, documentation of a specific entitlements API endpoint or SDK method, independent or hands-on corroboration.
